sources: https://washingtonks.net/campground (City of Washington, read 2026-11-06; page undated): 'Washington City Campground is located at 1100 D Street in Washington's City Park. There are twenty spaces available, with 20 OR 30 amp hookups at each space. There are also TWO 50-amp hookups available. The City of Washington does not reserve camping spots. All spots are available on a first-come first-serve basis. Guests may stay no more than 30 consecutive nights. Payment may be deposited into the drop box at the campground, or may be made at City Hall. RATE IS $15 PER NIGHT. Amenities include electrical and water hookups, dump site, bathrooms with showers and potable & non-potable water.'; footer 'City of Washington : (785) 325-2284', 301 C Street.
Esri World Imagery 2026-11-06 (400 m frame at the pin).
